roadmap.name: Platform Foundation
roadmap.summary: config/logging/errors/health/correlation IDs/OTel/graceful shutdown - the shared platformkit every later phase builds on.

roadmap.name: Application Registry
roadmap.summary: First real domain module: Application CRUD, cursor pagination, application.created/updated events.

roadmap.name: Identity
roadmap.summary: Provider abstraction over Keycloak (JWT validation + Admin API), platform-owned IdentityID/UserID, identities linkage table.

roadmap.name: Users
roadmap.summary: Platform person/account, separate from Identity. Soft-delete lifecycle, auto-provision on first login.

roadmap.name: Devices / Sessions
roadmap.summary: Per-user device tracking, push-token storage, revoke/reactivate, raw tokens never exposed in responses.

roadmap.name: Authorization / Access
roadmap.summary: authz.Service.Can(subject, action, resource) - RBAC (Postgres) + fine-grained ReBAC (OpenFGA), the one entry point every module uses.

roadmap.name: Tenants / Organizations
roadmap.summary: Tenant + Membership (owner/admin/member), scoped to an Application. Tenant-role checks answered from Membership data, not OpenFGA.

roadmap.name: Relationships / Social Graph
roadmap.summary: Generic RelationshipType/Relationship/Status graph: request/accept/decline/remove/block, no fixed 'friend/follower' semantics.

roadmap.name: Groups / Circles
roadmap.summary: Generic Group/GroupMember primitive (friend circles, teams, guilds - same shape), free-form product-defined member roles.

roadmap.name: Realtime Platform
roadmap.summary: New realtime-gateway service: hand-rolled WebSocket (RFC6455), Redis-fanned pub/sub for cross-replica delivery, TTL-based presence.

roadmap.name: Messaging
roadmap.summary: Conversation/Message/Delivery/ReadState/Reaction/Attachment, realtime delivery via a new shared rtbus package, durable storage in Postgres.

roadmap.name: Notification Platform
roadmap.summary: Notification/Template/Preference/Delivery across push/email/sms/in_app/realtime; only push is genuinely provider-tested locally (real device-token check).

roadmap.name: File / Media Platform
roadmap.summary: Presigned upload/download against real MinIO/S3, real MD5 checksum verification, ownership/permissions/retention/purge.

roadmap.name: Search Platform
roadmap.summary: SearchDocument/SearchProvider over OpenSearch; event-driven indexing via a new worker service polling the outbox.

roadmap.name: Background Jobs
roadmap.summary: Job/JobStatus/JobAttempt: immediate/scheduled/delayed/recurring/retry/dead-letter, executed by worker, never inline in HTTP handlers.

roadmap.name: Workflows
roadmap.summary: Temporal abstraction (Core Workflow API/SDK) for long-running, multi-step, compensating, scheduled processes - Temporal never exposed directly.

roadmap.name: Feature Flags
roadmap.summary: Feature/FeatureRule/FeatureEvaluation targeting app/env/user/tenant/platform/country/%/version, deterministic FNV-1a percentage bucketing.

roadmap.name: Remote Configuration
roadmap.summary: Typed key/value store scoped by (AppID, Environment, Key), full change-audit trail, config.updated/deleted events.

roadmap.name: Audit
roadmap.summary: Central Audit Service: actor/action/resource/timestamp/correlation/app/tenant/device/metadata. Immutable by omission AND a DB trigger.

roadmap.name: Privacy
roadmap.summary: Consent (append-only), preferences, retention policy, and cross-module ExportUserData/DeleteUserData via an Exporter/Deleter registry (users/devices/files/audit-export-only). Coordinated by a Temporal workflow core-api runs its own embedded worker for, since worker (separate module) can't reach core-api's internal packages.

roadmap.name: Trust & Safety
roadmap.summary: Mute/Report->ModerationCase (deduplicated)/Suspension/Ban/Appeal - Block reuses Phase 8's relationships, not duplicated. A new requireActive middleware makes Suspension/Ban actually restrict access platform-wide from one place. New shared ratelimit package (Valkey-backed) gates report spam; a critical AbuseSignal auto-opens a case.

roadmap.name: Billing / Entitlements
roadmap.summary: Entitlement (platform truth, HasEntitlement) kept separate from Payment (provider transaction record). PaymentProvider abstraction + registry; billing/stripe implements Stripe's real webhook HMAC signature scheme, live-validated without a Stripe account via self-signed test payloads. Apple IAP/Google Play deliberately deferred - no sandbox credentials available.

roadmap.name: Analytics
roadmap.summary: Generic event envelope, matching the roadmap's own field names verbatim. analytics_events is a landing buffer, never queried for analytics - a new worker pipeline batches unflushed rows as NDJSON into MinIO/S3 (a real data-lake landing pattern). Track is this platform's one open, unauthenticated write endpoint, IP-rate-limited instead of Bearer-gated.

roadmap.name: AI Gateway
roadmap.summary: Provider-neutral interface; real local inference via a new Ollama container (auto-pulled model, no vendor API key) - the one live-testable provider. Model routing, quotas (ratelimit reused again), real token/cost tracking, a genuine audit.Record per call, prompt/version metadata, timeouts, fallback. OpenAI/Anthropic/Google structurally supported, not implemented (no real credentials).

roadmap.name: Admin Portal
roadmap.summary: The control-plane UI (apps/admin, Next.js 15 App Router), always through service APIs, never direct DB queries - real Keycloak-authenticated session, live data on Users/Roles/Applications/Audit/Moderation/Feature Flags/Jobs/Configuration/System Health/Billing/AI Gateway, honest ComingSoon reasoning for every area whose backend endpoint is still self-scoped-only. Added authz's first HTTP surface and GET /v1/users (admin-wide listing) to close real gaps. Live-validated end to end with a real headless browser: login, dashboard, a full role grant/revoke round trip, logout.

roadmap.name: Backstage
roadmap.summary: A real @backstage/create-app instance (platform/backstage) whose catalog (catalog/system.yaml) is 24 real entities - a Group, the System, Components for all 3 services + admin + 16 domain modules with real dependsOn/providesApis, and 2 API entities embedding the full real OpenAPI/AsyncAPI specs. Filled in 11 stub module READMEs, fixed 2 real YAML bugs in the OpenAPI spec, generated ~110 missing OpenAPI paths from the actual Go route registrations, and live-validated the whole catalog loads with zero processing errors via the real catalog API.

roadmap.name: SDKs
roadmap.summary: Go (packages/go/coresdk), TypeScript (packages/typescript/core-sdk), and Dart (packages/flutter/core_sdk) - auth/token refresh, typed API calls, errors, pagination, GET-only retries, a real realtime WebSocket client, device registration, in all three. Each proven by a real consumer: apps/admin migrated its entire API layer to the TS SDK; apps/mobile's login/profile flow uses the Dart SDK (and closed a real Phase 9 gap - make flutter-test now passes). 39 unit tests total, all against real local HTTP servers, plus live validation against real Keycloak/core-api/realtime-gateway for all three.

roadmap.name: Observability Completion
roadmap.summary: New packages/go/platformkit/metrics gives every service a real /metrics endpoint and all 8 named dashboards real backing data (Kafka lag excluded - no real producer/consumer exists yet, an honest placeholder panel instead). logging.NewWithLoki ships structured logs directly to Loki's push API with real trace_id correlation. Grafana provisioning (previously mounted nowhere) now auto-loads Prometheus/Tempo/Loki datasources and a real dashboard; alerts.yml adds 6 live-evaluated Prometheus alerting rules. A real regression (broken WebSocket Hijack) was caught by the metrics middleware's own tests before ever reaching a running service.

roadmap.name: Platform Control Plane
roadmap.summary: New apps/admin/control-plane page - all 12 roadmap-named dimensions, real: applications/health (existing), real per-service versions (new config.Version - the actual git SHA, wired through health.Live/Health on all 3 services), real environment (from GET /v1/platform), the real dependency graph and DB ownership (docs/control/platform.json, a new machine-readable export from build_workbook.py's own data + catalog/system.yaml), real events (contracts/asyncapi), real live Prometheus alerts, a real git log for recent changes, and an honest Deployments placeholder (no CI/CD exists yet).

roadmap.name: AI Development Context
roadmap.summary: Audited and confirmed real per-module README/ownership/dependencies/API+event contracts/DB ownership already existed (Phases 26/29); closed the one genuine gap - 12 of 22 core-api modules had no handler-level (http_test.go) coverage - with real tests reading each module's actual source, never assumed. Rewrote docs/AI_CONTEXT.md and docs/architecture/overview.md from stale initial-commit stubs into a real description of the module pattern, testing convention, real-infra-only validation philosophy, and the phase loop this whole build actually followed.

components.name: core-api
components.description: The main platform API - almost every domain module below is implemented inside this one Go service.

components.name: realtime-gateway
components.description: Standalone WebSocket service - hand-rolled RFC6455 connections, channel subscriptions, and TTL-based presence, fanned out across replicas via Valkey pub/sub.

components.name: worker
components.description: Background execution service - job runner, OpenSearch indexer, analytics NDJSON pipeline, and a Temporal workflow worker. A separate Go module from core-api, so it can never import core-api's internal packages directly.

components.name: admin
components.description: The Admin Portal (Phase 25) - a Next.js 15 App Router UI over core-api, real Keycloak-authenticated session, no direct database access.

components.name: identity
components.description: Auth provider abstraction (Keycloak today), token validation, identity<->user linkage.

components.name: users
components.description: Platform person/account, profile, soft-delete lifecycle; also owns device/session registration and revocation.

components.name: access
components.description: Can(subject, action, resource) - RBAC roles plus a fine-grained OpenFGA-backed ReBAC check, the one authorization entry point every other domain module uses.

components.name: social
components.description: Generic relationship graph (request/accept/decline/remove/block) and generic Group/GroupMember primitive - the platform never hardcodes what a relationship or a group means.

components.name: communication
components.description: Conversations/messages/delivery/read-state/reactions (core-api) plus real-time fan-out over WebSocket (realtime-gateway) - two services, one capability boundary.

components.name: notifications
components.description: Notification/Template/Preference/Delivery across push/email/sms/in_app/realtime; only push is genuinely provider-tested against a real device-token check locally.

components.name: content
components.description: Presigned file upload/download against real MinIO/S3 (files), and search documents over real OpenSearch, indexed asynchronously by worker (search).

components.name: commerce
components.description: Entitlement (platform truth) kept separate from Payment (provider transaction record); Stripe adapter live-validated via real webhook HMAC signatures.

components.name: events-workflows
components.description: Background jobs (immediate/scheduled/delayed/recurring/retry/dead-letter, executed by worker) and Temporal-backed durable workflows.

components.name: configuration
components.description: Feature flags with deterministic percentage rollout, and a typed remote-config key/value store with a full change-audit trail.

components.name: trust-safety
components.description: Mute/Report->ModerationCase/Suspension/Ban/Appeal; a requireActive middleware makes an active Suspension/Ban actually restrict platform access from one place.

components.name: privacy-compliance
components.description: Central immutable audit trail (trigger-enforced), plus consent/preferences/retention and cross-module export/deletion via a registry, coordinated by an embedded Temporal worker.

components.name: analytics
components.description: Generic event envelope ingestion (this platform's one open, unauthenticated write endpoint) - a landing buffer only, batched to MinIO/S3 as NDJSON by worker, never queried in place.

components.name: ai
components.description: Provider-neutral completions API - "products must not call AI vendors directly" is enforced structurally. Real local inference via Ollama; OpenAI/Anthropic/Google structurally supported, not implemented.

components.name: operations
components.description: platformkit (config, logging, errors, health, correlation IDs, OTel, graceful shutdown) - the shared foundation every Go service imports. No dependencies of its own.

components.name: platform
components.description: The Application Registry (which applications exist) and multi-tenancy (Tenant/Membership scoped to an Application).

components.name: coresdk-go
components.description: Go SDK - auth/token refresh, typed API calls, errors, pagination, GET-only retries, a realtime WebSocket client, device registration.

components.name: coresdk-typescript
components.description: TypeScript SDK - isomorphic (fetch/WebSocket/crypto.randomUUID). apps/admin's real API layer, not a parallel unused artifact.

components.name: coresdk-dart
components.description: Dart SDK (a pure Dart package, no Flutter dependency) - apps/mobile's real login/profile flow depends on it.
